items: portable folding solar panel with built-in charge controller
why: The shopper asked for one product, a portable panel with the controller already built in, and ChatGPT answered with four carded single products (Renogy 100W and 200W suitcases, ACOPOWER PLK, VEVOR 200W), each sold as one item; the battery it mentions is the thing being charged, not something the shopper must add. What decides the pick is the controller's battery-chemistry support (LiFePO4 profile, PWM vs MPPT) and panel wattage, so the page should compare models and recommend one.
